The plate is a large square, roughly 26 cm across, which spans about 460 px in the photo. That puts the scale at about 17.7 px per cm.

The pizza piece measures about 130 px by 80 px, so roughly 7.5 cm by 4.5 cm. It looks like a rectangular cheese pizza slice about 1.5 cm thick.

Volume is about 7.5 × 4.5 × 1.5 ≈ 50 cm³. Bread-based pizza is fairly dense, so I'd put the mass at about 60 g.

At roughly 2.7 kcal/g for cheese pizza, that comes to about 160 kcal.
